title: feat(pm): no open card leaves a lane without a state; triage sweeps the five disjunctions exactly

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:写入门禁现在拦两种半写:开着的卡被摘掉最后一个 `pm:*` 状态却不补态(除非同笔补态、补 `needs-user-decision` 或关卡),以及停放态(queue/blocked/hold)的卡留着 assignee。三个写口共用一个判定:`label-write.mjs`、中继的 actions 文件入口 `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`、`close-cards.mjs`。新增 `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs`,按分诊职责原文跑五个析取、全量翻页、与平台 `total_count` 对数,不等即 `INCOMPLETE`。技能文字补四处:`Part of` 落地后剩余物落车道一态、留守卡落态、搁置同笔降 p3 并记 `Restart-grade:`、「待维护者」逐张列卡龄。
- 为什么改:27 张 p1 只有 5 张在队列,主因是摘 `pm:dispatched` 不补态的半写,加上分诊的兜底筛查是窄化的手敲版(① 当「无标签」、③ 漏跑、截 12 条)。
- 风险与回滚:只动 PM 工具与技能文字,不碰产品包;新拒收只在写会留下无态卡或带人停放卡时触发,`--release` 照常合法(自测钉住)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` 的 `refuseStatelessWrite`;`scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` 的 `stateGuardRows`/`readStateGuard`;`scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs` 的 `classify`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs --self-test`,预期 `✓ first-touch-sweep self-test: 45 cases pass across 5 batteries`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(受管面 Tier S,席内契约复审后入队)。

## What changes

**Item 1 — the stateless write, one predicate at every door that strips a state.**

- `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`: new `refuseStatelessWrite` (exported with `PARKED_STATE_LABELS`, `STATELESS_RULE`, `PARKED_RULE`), asked at step ② on step ①'s own read, before the transport, for the plain write, `--comment-file` and `--release` alike. Two halves:
  - the strip: a `pm:*` state the target drops on an OPEN issue while the target carries no state at all is refused (exit 2, zero writes). Legal exits: the same write adds another state, adds `needs-user-decision`, or closes the card; a card with two states losing one keeps one and passes (the ONE-OF repair).
  - the holder: a target parked in `pm:queue` / `pm:blocked` / `pm:on-hold` that keeps an assignee is refused when the write moved a state or an assignee. A write that moved neither (a regrade, a domain) did not make the pair and passes, so triage's hold regrade is never blocked by an old assignee.
  - A pull request carries no card state, so it is never judged (the kind rule's cleanup stays legal). Labels compare case-insensitively. No flag lets either half through. `--release` (`pm:dispatched` to `pm:queue`, every assignee cleared) is pinned legal.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (the relay's actions-file door): `stateGuardRows` picks each card a stroke takes a `pm:*` state off, parks, or assigns someone to (only the read knows whether it already sits parked), without closing; `readStateGuard` reads it once (sharing the kind rule's read of the same card, so one GET per number); `judgeStateGuard` applies the stroke's steps in order and asks label-write's predicate. Refused is exit 2, unreadable exit 3, nothing sent for the whole file, dry run included. A stroke closing its card reads nothing.
- `scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs`: `packCard` asks the same row picker of its pack and refuses one that strips without closing; the self-test pins that every pack closes what it strips.

**Item 4 — `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs` (new, report-only).** Walks every open issue over REST (`/issues?state=open`, every page, pull requests dropped), compares the count with `GET /search/issues` `total_count` (and `incomplete_results`), and runs ① to ⑤ as `triage-duties.md` writes them: ① no `pm:*`, no `needs-user-decision`, no `domain:*` (a `finding` card with no domain is bare); ② `pm:queue` without `domain:*` on the multi-lane board; ③ `domain:*` with no pm state; ④ `pm:queue` + `domain:*` without `priority:*`; ②③④ settle 2 minutes; exclusions `tracking`, `status:parked`, `pm:seat`, `qa-run`; ⑤ with `--since`, created in the window with `pm:queue` / `priority:*` labelled in the creation minute (read from label events, never by actor). Exits 0 complete with all five run, 2 usage, 3 prerequisite, 4 `sweep INCOMPLETE` or `sweep PARTIAL` (no `--since`, ⑤ not run). Its self-test pins every rule phrase it is built from as a substring of `triage-duties.md`.

**Items 2, 3, 5 — pm-dispatch text.**

- `references/state-machine.md`: 「开着的卡离手恒落一态」 in the cross-state rules; on-hold: entering hold lowers the card to `priority:p3` in the same stroke with ` · Restart-grade: pN` at the end of the `Restart-when:` line, a restart restores it, trackers and epics the same.
- `SKILL.md` state table: the queue row keeps 「`pm:queue` 卡恒无 assignee,有即半态」 verbatim and adds `pm:blocked`/`pm:on-hold`; the `pm:on-hold` row names the p3 drop and `Restart-grade:`.
- `references/landing-operations.md`: the `Part of` close-out says what to do: in the MERGED stroke the remainder takes a state for its lane (`pm:queue` + its lane's `domain:*`, re-domained if it belongs to another lane; `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:`; hold + `Restart-when:`), the assignee cleared, and a comment says what was delivered and who owns the rest.
- `references/seat-lifecycle.md`: a stay-behind card takes its lane's state in the `seat-offline` stroke; one that does not, triage sets on reading that knock, in that round.
- `references/triage-duties.md`: the 「待维护者」 list names every open `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` card with its age; the five disjunctions run through the script, never narrowed by hand; the self-repair hold line takes the p3 drop.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: four ruled raises, see Verification.

## Why

Measured by triage on `main` the filing evening and quoted on the card: of 27 open p1 cards, 5 were queued; #32087 and #32908 (p1) and #32984 and #33353 (p2) had `pm:dispatched` removed with no state added; the `finding` cards #33402 to #33404 waited about three hours because the hand sweep ran ① as `no:label`, skipped ③ and cut results at 12. Ruling: the maintainer in the triage seat's session, 「优化建议，可以skills立卡优化」 (quoted on the card).

Live read of the new sweep on this branch, 2026-11-14 22:40Z: 326 open issues walked over 5 pages, platform count 326, complete; ① 4, ② 0, ③ 0, ④ 0, ⑤ 22.

## Acceptance notes

- **The holder half and 「工已完而被门禁卡住的同用本态」.** The `pm:blocked` row lets a card whose work is done but held by a gate use `pm:blocked`, and in-flight cards keep their assignee until MERGED. The card names `pm:blocked` among the parked states, so such a card must now clear its assignee when it enters `pm:blocked`. On the board today 2 of 24 open `pm:blocked` cards carry an assignee; they are not refused for unrelated writes (a write that moves no state and no assignee passes). If the seat wants done-and-gated cards to keep their holder, that is a one-line carve-out and a ruling.
- **⑤ matches cards filed with labels at creation** (seat-filed cards through `issue-create.mjs` carry `pm:queue` and `priority:*` from the first minute): 22 in the last 4.5 h, #33484 itself among them. That is the rule as written (「照未分诊首触;⛔ 不凭 actor」); the script does not read triage's audit comments, so a card already first-touched still lists until the window moves past it.
- **The new self-test is not yet run by CI.** Wiring it needs a root `package.json` alias and a step in `.github/workflows/lint.yml` (Tier H), both outside this order's surface. `check-self-test-wired` does not flag it because no workflow runs the script. Carrier: the skills seat, as a follow-up.
- **Triage's patrol prompt is not held in the repo**: the routine fires the skill, and `triage-duties.md` (read every fire) now names the script.
- An `assign`-only stroke through `dispatch.mjs` reads its card and is refused onto a parked card, as `label-write.mjs` refuses it on its own read (review round 1, S1).
- Without `--since` the sweep skips ⑤, so its verdict is `sweep PARTIAL` and its exit 4; `CLEAN` and exit 0 need a complete walk on which all five ran (review round 1, S2).
- Not done here, per the order: the regrade of #27124, #27287 and #32481 (triage's, after this lands). No card was relabelled.

## Verification

Size: 10 files, +874 / -29 (under the 3000-line line).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 51 gate families for this diff; all 51 ran green at head `d00151d4`, after the lint closure was built under the build lock.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation: `51 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 51 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- Also run, not derived: `node scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs --self-test` (45 cases, 5 batteries) and the fleet-write execute self-test.
- Self-test counts: label-write 223, fleet-write dispatch 399, close-cards 228.
